title: RTM Matrix page shows live requirements and coverage
objective: Confirm the RTM Matrix page lists every requirement / user story of the open iteration with coverage pills matching the API.
steps: Open RTM > RTM Matrix for the demo project. Compare the number of rows and the Fully/Partial/Not covered counts with LIVE-05 evidence.
expected: Row count and coverage statuses equal the live API summary; each requirement shows its linked Gherkin tests.

title: RTM export to PDF
objective: Confirm the Export PDF button produces a readable traceability document.
steps: On the RTM Matrix page click Export PDF and open the downloaded file.
expected: PDF contains one line per requirement with story, ACs, tests, status and coverage.

title: Quality Prediction page shows score, label and probabilities
objective: Confirm a selected test case shows its extracted features, formula score, model label and class probabilities.
steps: Open RTM > Quality Prediction, select a test case from the dropdown.
expected: Features, 0-100 score, High/Medium/Low label and probabilities are displayed and match API-08 / LIVE-07.

title: Improve action shows gaps and before/after scores
objective: Confirm the Improve button lists the detected gaps, the rewritten Gherkin and the re-calculated score.
steps: On Quality Prediction select a Low/Medium test case and click Improve.
expected: Gap list with recommendations, improved Given/When/Then text, before and after score and label.

title: Coverage Gaps page ranks gaps and generates a test
objective: Confirm gaps are sorted by risk with factor breakdown, and a generated test can be added to the RTM.
steps: Open RTM > Coverage Gaps, expand the top gap, Generate Test Case for a missing AC, then Add to RTM; reopen RTM Matrix.
expected: Highest risk first; generated Gherkin uses the AC wording; the test appears in the matrix with source 'generated'.

title: Clear error when Component 1 is stopped
objective: Confirm the UI shows a readable error banner rather than crashing when Component 1 is unavailable.
steps: Stop Component 1 (port 8001), refresh the RTM Matrix page, then restart Component 1.
expected: Error banner mentioning Component 1; page recovers after restart and refresh.

title: Dashboard and Portfolio agree with the matrix
objective: Confirm the Dashboard totals and the Portfolio lists are consistent with the RTM Matrix.
steps: Open RTM > Dashboard and RTM > Portfolio for the same project.
expected: Dashboard test totals equal the matrix; portfolio items reference tests that exist in the matrix.
